Development and Training

Pursue your interests and develop your skills.

Employees can take advantage of tuition assistance for Northwestern University courses and certificate programs, as well as courses taken elsewhere.

They can also take advantage of training programs and professional development opportunities through Northwestern.

Tuition Benefits

Eligible employees and their dependents receive reduced tuition at Northwestern and other schools:

  • Reduced tuition benefits
  • Portable tuition benefits
  • Reduced tuition for dependents
